home.hero_subtitle: POCUS Students and Residents Medical Alliance
home.hero_description: A learning community for medical students and residents centered on Point-of-Care Ultrasound. Break through university barriers — learn and grow together.
home.about_text: POCUS Students and Residents Medical Alliance (PSMA) is a community where medical students and residents across Japan can learn and connect around POCUS. We break down barriers between universities to build ultrasound skills that matter at the bedside.
home.feature_1_text: Regular hands-on seminars where you can learn probe technique, from fundamentals to clinical applications. Open to all levels.
home.feature_2_text: Connect with medical students nationwide for information sharing and collaborative learning opportunities.
home.feature_3_text: In-depth interviews with POCUS faculty and senior residents, giving you access to frontline knowledge and perspectives.

about.title: About PSMA
about.mission_text: To create an environment where medical students and residents across Japan can learn POCUS, contributing to the skill development of the next generation of clinicians.
about.vision_text: Toward a future where POCUS is standard in medical education. PSMA aims to be the pioneering community leading that change.
about.history_text: Founded in 2024 in response to limited POCUS learning opportunities for medical students. Today, students and residents from multiple universities participate in our growing community.

activities.title: Activities & Events
activities.subtitle: Discover what PSMA does
activities.seminar_text: We regularly host hands-on POCUS seminars where participants can practice with actual probes, covering fundamentals through clinical applications.
activities.workshop_text: Online study sessions accessible from anywhere in Japan — case presentations, image interpretation practice, and skills sharing.
activities.conference_text: We attend and report on POCUS-related conferences in Japan and abroad, sharing the latest developments with our community.
activities.upcoming_empty: Events are being planned. Follow our social media for the latest updates.
